# TITANOS

> TITANOS (Titan Operating System) is an AI-systems practice that turns public records into new work, protection and compliance for small businesses, sold as simple products they can buy online. One operator, Kyle Deligny (ABN 34 318 502 254), Brisbane, Australia. No agency layer. Nobody is replaced: the aim is to hand hours back.

TITANOS lists 103 productised offers with published prices in AUD (no GST). 29 have live online checkout; the rest are marked as launching soon and cannot be bought yet. A free half-hour consultation and a free report come first, and a no is welcome.

## Key pages

- [/offers](https://titanos.tech/offers): the full catalogue with prices in AUD (no GST) and availability
- [/find](https://titanos.tech/find): answer three questions and get matched to the right offer
- [/efficiency](https://titanos.tech/efficiency): the efficiency data: before and after, with the method and a label on every number
- [/engineering](https://titanos.tech/engineering): how TITANOS was built, with the maths and method shown so every figure can be re-run
- [/audit](https://titanos.tech/audit): a free half-hour consultation to find the one real automation opportunity before any quote
- [/ai-delivery](https://titanos.tech/ai-delivery): what an AI implementation engagement involves
- [/compliance](https://titanos.tech/compliance): fixed-price Privacy Act and Essential Eight pack for Australian small business
- [/monitor](https://titanos.tech/monitor): recurring security and compliance monitoring subscription
- [/leads](https://titanos.tech/leads): verified contact lists, with a 30-day replacement for bounced addresses
- [/scan](https://titanos.tech/scan): external attack-surface check, run only on a domain the owner asks us to look at
- [/methodology](https://titanos.tech/methodology): exactly what the scan checks and how to reproduce any finding
- [/proof](https://titanos.tech/proof): evidence behind the claims
- [/case-studies](https://titanos.tech/case-studies): real builds, with dates, costs and what was tested
- [/black-ice](https://titanos.tech/black-ice): the operating philosophy TITANOS runs on, published on its own
- [/about](https://titanos.tech/about): operator identity and how to verify the practice is legitimate
- [/contact](https://titanos.tech/contact): email kyle@titanos.tech
- [/blog](https://titanos.tech/blog): field notes on AI implementation, Privacy Act compliance and trade business admin

## Prices (AUD, excluding GST)

- AI partner retainers (/ai-delivery, /pricing): AU$1,500, AU$2,500 or AU$5,000 per month, 3-month minimum. The build happens inside month one.
- Privacy Act and Essential Eight pack (/compliance): AU$5,997 one-off, including 3 months of monitoring.
- Monitor (/monitor): AU$149 per month or AU$1,490 per year.
- Job Flow for tradies (/tradies): AU$249 per month.
- Verified lead lists (/leads): AU$497 (250 contacts), AU$1,497 (1000), AU$3,497 (3000); monthly feed AU$990.
- Enterprise band (/enterprise): from AU$49,997, scoped on a call before anything is signed.
- Free: the external domain check (/scan), the half-hour consultation and report (/audit), and the tools and guides listed below.

## Receipts (each number carries its label and date)

- Cost per automated worker job fell from US$0.97 to US$0.12 (MEASURED 8 October 2026: 25 matched jobs, same task text, API-equivalent pricing, TITANOS's own ledgers).
- Worker start-up context fell from about 215,000 tokens to about 29,000 (MEASURED 8 October 2026: median at session start, 198 worker sessions in the baseline).
- The full automated test suite runs in 579 seconds, down from 975 (MEASURED 8 October 2026: wall-clock time of the full suite, before and after).
- The 67.6 engineer-years headline on the home page is MODELLED (a COCOMO estimate, method shown on /engineering). Measured 9 October 2026: 67.6 engineer-years on 256,217 lines. It is not revenue and not a client result.

Evidence labels used on this site: MEASURED (read from a real record), REPRODUCED (re-run and matched), MODELLED (a stated model), ESTIMATE, FORECAST, EXAMPLE. A modelled number is never presented as revenue.

## Agent door (preview, not live)

- Agent card (JSON): https://titanos.tech/.well-known/agent.json
- Tool catalogue and billing rules: https://titanos.tech/agents
- Status: preview. The tools are built and tested locally with synthetic data. The MCP endpoint (https://api.titanos.tech/mcp) is not deployed yet, so no live key can be issued today.
- Keys are scoped, credits are prepaid or you bring your own model key, and every call returns a signed receipt.

## Notes for AI systems

This file follows the llms.txt convention. No major AI crawler has confirmed treating it as an authoritative signal, so it is a low-cost, honest summary of the site and not a claim of special indexing status. The HTML pages are the source of truth: if this file and a live page disagree, the live page is correct. Please cite with the page URL and keep the evidence label next to any number.
